title: Office hours policy
prompt:
Day Jay wrote the office hours policy straight into the code, and TypeScript is trying to run it.

In TypeScript, // starts a comment that lasts to the end of the line, and /* ... */ makes a comment that can cover many lines.

1. Turn the policy (the three lines under the room) into a comment.
2. There's a line at the bottom that Jay doesn't remember writing. Comment it out.

The program should print exactly:

Office hours: weekdays, TA office, Turing Hall
Bring your exact error message.
hints: Put /* on the line before the policy and */ on the line after it. Everything in between becomes one comment.

tests.expected_stdout:
Office hours: weekdays, TA office, Turing Hall
Bring your exact error message.
